timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 81-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.64, creatinine 1.03, hemoglobin 12.9, platelets 263, sodium 134, wbc 6.6; vitals dbp 66-70, heart_rate 73-77, map 87-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 127-129, spo2 97-99, temp 36.8-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.04, hemoglobin 13, platelets 265, sodium 140, wbc 6.7; vitals dbp 65-70, heart_rate 73-78, map 86-91, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 125-133, spo2 98, temp 36.9-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 81-year-old female, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
